title: Excarnification
summary: EXCARNIFICA'TION, noun [Latin excarnifico, to cut in pieces, from caro, flesh.] The act of cutting off flesh, or of depriving of flesh.

inlines.v: EXCARNIFICA'TION, noun [Latin excarnifico, to cut in pieces, from caro, flesh.] The act of cutting off flesh, or of depriving of flesh.
